newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: ENK chief to raise stake to 8.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: ENK chief to raise stake to 8.3 pct.

text.p: The president of South Korea's ENK Telecommunication Co has notified the government of a plan to raise his personal stake in the firm to 8.31 percent from 6.25 percent, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Thursday.
Choi Hyon-yol plans to buy 100,000 shares on the open market in order to strengthen his management control. No further details on the timing of the share purchases were given.
Under South Korean regulations, the government must be notified of any single stake in a company above five percent.
Choi, his immediate family, and several affiliates currently control almost 12 percent of ENK's shares.
ENK, a speaker manufacturer, was formerly known as Sammi Sound Technology.
